Medical Store Database

Upload your existing PDF list. The app will read the PDF text and try to identify Store Name, Area and Territory automatically.

Best PDF format: a selectable-text table/list with columns such as Store Name, Area, Territory. Scanned/image-only PDFs need OCR and may require a later OCR mode.

📄 Upload Territory PDF

Select City → Territory, then upload the PDF. Existing stores are matched by Store Code first, then by Store Name + City, so the same store is not duplicated. Matching stores are moved into the selected territory.

Territory Master: checking…
Ready. Select City → Territory and choose its PDF. After import, the master can be locked so future HTML upgrades cannot overwrite it.

＋ Add New Customer

Add a new Medical Store, Pharmacy or Doctor Pharmacy. The customer is saved on this device and will appear only under the selected city.

Master Login

Master controls City → Territory → Salesman → Day assignments. All settings stay saved on this device until Admin edits them.
